# zlib / zlib_uncompress_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `zlib_uncompress_fuzzer` ([source](source/zlib_uncompress_fuzzer.cc), unmodified) over zlib 1.4 (madler/zlib at 99623ef7).

uncompress into a 256 KiB static buffer; the return code is tested but both branches return 0.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zlib 1.4 at commit 99623ef7.
- zlib carries the public inflate fix https://github.com/madler/zlib/pull/1390 in every build.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing. Its halts statements say only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer. Its agreement statements say only that the code never crashes or trips a sanitizer, and allow a run that never ends. Its bound statements say only how often its builds may disagree. Its decidability statements say only that some program decides where its builds agree. Its classifier statements say only how the classifier programs of its pairs answer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch zlib` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `zlib_uncompress_fuzzer.plain` | 66,368 | `3273b22cde6e0e547cdc71aa69b38768507bce8bf084e0ed5c77b1f2e0a7ba27` |
| ubsan | `zlib_uncompress_fuzzer.ubsan` | 71,192 | `58c510ea94ad9ed5c89145ffff0b1880d01b53ec5745f238851fa28d73531598` |
| asan | `zlib_uncompress_fuzzer.asan` | 796,168 | `b931481c1945d1b7a7478169c007d4cb12aa40beaf38fc9c7f2695321555d571` |
| asan-ubsan | `zlib_uncompress_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 801,544 | `4868bf406fafe163b5d3665560f60e1466c2910c933eb5dce9a131e01de4b332` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
